RoyalTitleDef.label: Squire
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn attendant learning the duties of arms and service. The first honor earned in service to the Westerlands. Western titles confer standing, not psychic powers, and never forbid honest work.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Hedge Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A landless knight whose courage and service have earned recognition from the houses of the Westerlands.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Landed Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A knight recognized as worthy of a landed household and its duties. This honor grants standing, not a new settlement.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A recognized head of a western house, bound to protect its people and honor sworn obligations.

RoyalTitleDef.label: High Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A High Lord, also called a Great Lord, commands the respect of lesser houses and carries greater responsibility for the Westerlands.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord Paramount
RoyalTitleDef.description: A paramount ruler honored above the great houses of the Westerlands for exceptional service and leadership.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Warden of the West
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Westerlands' highest honor, recognizing a military guardian of the West and defender of its borders. It grants your House standing without replacing the Westerlands' Warden or transferring their lands.
